review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an argument that the best students in academic deserve receive rewards, other say that students improving should gain same encouraged rewards. I am strongly believe that two groups of students should receive praise.

Admittedly, the best student who have the best scores in the exam deserve receive gift is all right. Students have diligently applied themself to their studies, they deserve their praise and privilege, so this also may encourages these students and others to study harder to win the reward. This also help others propel towards academic gains. Furthermore, these kind of competition seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. And students can used this reality and thrive in face of fierce competitions, which can enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, not only the best students in academic gain the rewards, students are improving in process their studies also deserve receive gift. Since when only few smart students can come first and received the rewards, lead to cause others think that their efforts is futile since they can not surpass those outstanding individuals, which prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, finally that they are gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, emphasizing improvements which encourages all the students to that they need to constantly improve themself. So they are irrespective of how well they have been or are performing, this contribute more the constantly desire to outdo themself, even when benefits themself more than their competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that the rewards received them, who have a highest scores success and students the effort to improve themself.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài trên các trang đã xác minh.

review.overall: Em đã cố gắng triển khai đủ hai thân bài và bốn hướng ý của buổi học. Tuy nhiên, bài có rất nhiều câu ghép sai ngay ở phần nền: “I am strongly believe”, “students can used this reality”, “when only few ... lead to cause” và câu kết không nói trọn một ý. Phần sau Body 2 có ý vượt bản thân nhưng quan hệ giữa các bước gần như không theo dõi được vì chủ ngữ và động từ bị chắp nối. Mức độ vận dụng kiến thức trong bài này rất yếu; em cần nghiêm túc viết lại từng câu theo đúng chủ ngữ–động từ, tự giải thích lỗi trước khi đối chiếu bản chữa. Bản cũ gọi câu đầu Body 1 chỉ là một lý do cụ thể, nhưng dù sai ngữ pháp nó nêu chính sách thưởng nhóm điểm cao; lý do công sức bắt đầu ở câu kế và chưa được báo rõ. Body 1 có “Furthermore”, Body 2 có “Moreover” đúng cho ý thứ hai; ý đầu của cả hai Body thiếu mốc riêng.

paragraphs: There is an argument that students with the best academic results deserve rewards, while others say that students who make progress should also receive rewards. I strongly believe that both groups of students should receive praise.

Admittedly, high-achieving students deserve recognition for their results. Initially, these students have diligently applied themselves to their studies. They deserve their praises and privileges. This may also encourage these students and others to study harder to win the reward. Such motivation may raise academic performance more broadly. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students can become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, schools should reward not only high-achieving students but also those who make progress in their studies. To begin with, if only a few high-achieving students receive rewards, others may think that their effort is futile. This is because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, rewarding progress can encourage all students to be diligent and help them understand that they need to keep improving themselves. They can do so irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves may benefit them more than the determination to defeat others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that schools should reward both students with the highest results and students who have made progress.

Rà can/may + động từ nguyên mẫu; học sinh số nhiều đi với themselves.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
